assumptions: Priceoverview accepts an explicit currency but supplies no order depth.
Seller proceeds use the project default fee model. Native sale submission uses seller proceeds, so some requested prices round to the same actual listing price.
No execution-speed or profit-optimality claim can be made from these quotes alone.
